subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: have you killed the rats said the mayor yes i have replied the piper give me the promised money how funny you are said the mayor take only fifty. Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: "Have you killed the rats?" said the Mayor. "Yes, I have", replied the piper. "Give me the promised money." "How funny you are!" said the Mayor. "Take only fifty." Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book 178
